The issue: `gh repo view .` should work — treat "." as current repo. Fix: in viewRun, if RepoArg == "." use BaseRepo. Also README in current branch — could pass current branch when RepoArg is "."? The PR says: takes remote branch of current user if exists, otherwise local readme. Let's implement: RepoArg "." → use BaseRepo, and try to determine current branch via git to pass to RepositoryReadme; if no local readme, fall back gracefully (NotFoundError already handled → shows "no README"). Simpler: when RepoArg == ".", use BaseRepo and set branch from git current branch.

Need a way to get current branch. Check what's available—maybe factory has GitClient? This is older cli version (v1.x). Check cmdutil.Factory fields.
